title: Hey Nonny

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Hey Nonny offers unforgettable private event experiences in the heart of downtown Arlington Heights. Whether you’re planning an intimate wedding, shower, luncheon, meeting, rehearsal dinner, milestone celebration, or bar/bat mitzvah, our team is here to make it exceptional. ‍Events can be hosted in the Lounge, the Venue, or across both rooms combined, with our signature retractable wall creating one flowing space with customizable menus featuring elevated seasonal comfort cuisine, and our bar team can craft drink packages tailored to any occasion. The Venue offers a truly unique backdrop: a functioning, intimate music hall that has welcomed world-class performers from across the country.
